DataEncoder in rarimo/passport-zk-circui.Short Description of the Vulnerability: The DateEncoder template decomposes day, month, and year values into decimal and remainder components, but fails to constrain the remainder signals (dayRest, monthRest, yearRest) to the valid range [0,9]. This allows a malicious prover to assign arbitrary values to these signals that satisfy the arithmetic constraint but violate the intended digit decomposition invariant.
DataEncoder in rarimo/passport-zk-circui.Short Description of the Exploit: A malicious prover can provide inputs where the remainder signals exceed the valid digit range [0,9], causing the circuit to accept invalid date encodings that do not correspond to legitimate date values.
DataEncoder in rarimo/passport-zk-circui.Proposed Mitigation: Add explicit range checks to constrain dayRest, monthRest, and yearRest to the range [0,9] using LessThan and Num2Bits templates from circomlib. This ensures only valid digit values satisfy the constraints.
